Beigewood

Design features at a glance

  • ÆON™ Technology

    This enhancement makes our HPL 3X more resistant to wear, scratches, and scuffs than other laminates.

  • Cross Grain Available

    This woodgrain laminate design can be turned sideways for a better yield. Explore available products for details.

  • Directional Design

    This is a directionally specific pattern that may impact placement and installation.

  • Eco Credentials

    Third-party certification available for this product. See Technical Specs & Certifications below.

  • Stick & Seal

    Adhesive and color matched caulk is available for seamless bonding and sealing.
